login.headline: Sign in to PreLink
login.sub: A calmer way to look after your wellbeing.
login.noAccount: Don't have an account? Create one

signup.headline: Create your account
signup.sub: Takes about a minute — you can adjust everything later in Settings.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in

forgotPassword.headline: Reset your password
forgotPassword.sub: We'll send a reset link to your email.
forgotPassword.success: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

language.headline: Welcome to PreLink
language.sub: A calmer way to look after your wellbeing. Choose the language you're most comfortable with.

consent.headline: Wellness support only
consent.sub: This is the only consent needed to use PreLink at all. Nothing else is bundled in.
consent.stage1Description: PreLink notices everyday patterns in mood, movement, and habits. It does not diagnose or predict any condition.

baseline.headline: Getting your starting point
baseline.sub: This helps PreLink meet you where you are from day one — nothing here is medical information.

home.reentrySub: Life happens. We saved your place.

Foggy.title: One tap, that's it today
Foggy.body: Low-key day noted. Here's the smallest possible win — no pressure for more.

Okay.title: A steady, easy step
Okay.body: A simple daily option, take it at whatever pace suits you.

Good.title: Feeling up for a bit more?
Good.body: Good energy today. Here's a slightly fuller option, still optional.

Light.title: Feeling up for a bit more?
Light.body: Good energy today. Here's a slightly fuller option, still optional.

reentryHero.title: Today's step takes 20 seconds
reentryHero.body: No missed days, no catching up needed. Just today.

mind.name: Mind
mind.sub: The activity below works today. The trend judgment doesn't show yet — no clinical lead has approved what a meaningful change looks like.
mind.neutralMessage: Not enough information available. No clinical interpretation is shown here yet.
mind.taskBody: Entirely optional — tap to try it.

heart.headline: Heart isn't available yet
heart.sub: This area is intentionally deferred. Before it can track anything real — like blood pressure readings — we need to define the data source, device validation, and clinical handling first. Nothing is hidden here; it simply isn't built.

weight.headline: Weight isn't available yet
weight.sub: This area is intentionally deferred until units, source, and a reviewed protocol are defined — no weight-loss targets or automatic alerts without that in place first.

calm.headline: Calm
calm.sub: A quick self-check and an optional breathing break. Not a mood diagnosis or risk score of any kind.
calm.stressLabel: How are things feeling right now?
calm.breatheBody: Entirely optional — tap to try it, stop anytime.

breathing.headline: Let's breathe for a moment
breathing.sub: Follow the circle. Stop anytime — there's no target to hit.

carePlan.headline: A few optional ideas
carePlan.sub: A few gentle suggestions — nothing you have to do.
carePlan.walkTitle: Some people find a short walk helps midday.
carePlan.connectTitle: Staying connected tends to help too.
carePlan.connectBody: A quick call with family, whenever feels right.

assessmentTask.headline: Which word did you see a moment ago?
assessmentTask.sub: No right or wrong pace — take your time.
assessmentTask.doneSub: Results are reviewed gently — never shown as a raw score.

consent2.note: Appearing now because it's actually relevant, not on a fixed schedule.
consent2.headline: Pattern awareness
consent2.sub: This stage lets PreLink show you non-diagnostic trends from what you've logged. You can turn this off anytime in Settings.
consent2.stageDescription: No scores, no risk language, no thresholds. Just gentle, plain-language observations.

insight.headline: Your recent check-ins
insight.neutralMessage: No clinical interpretation is available yet. This isn't a judgment that something is wrong — it means the review process isn't switched on yet.
insight.sub: Whatever this screen eventually says, you can always reach out to a professional — the option below works regardless.
insight.prepareSummary: Prepare a summary to discuss with a clinician

consent4.note: The last of the 4 — only asked because you tapped the button above.
consent4.headline: Prepare a summary
consent4.sub: This pilot doesn't yet have a connected clinician or clinic. This prepares a plain-language summary (never raw scores) that you can review, download, or share yourself.
consent4.stageDescription: Nobody is automatically notified. There is no monitored queue on the other end yet — PreLink is not an emergency or continuously monitored service.

summaryPreview.headline: Here's exactly what's included
summaryPreview.sub: Review this before continuing. Nothing is sent anywhere outside PreLink yet.

summaryPrepared.headline: Summary prepared
summaryPrepared.status: Status: Saved — no connected partner yet
summaryPrepared.sub: This pilot doesn't have a contracted clinic yet, so nothing was sent. Once a care partner is connected, this is exactly where that hand-off would happen — and you'd be asked to confirm it, not us.

caregiverHome.lockedSub: This view unlocks once an invite is sent and accepted from Settings → Invite a caregiver.
caregiverHome.engagementBody: Checked in most days — nothing needed from you right now.
caregiverHome.encouragementSent: Sent — Mona will see this next time she opens PreLink.
caregiverHome.trustNote: Caregivers see stability summaries only — never raw scores, individual answers, or data exports.

clinicianGate.headline: Organizational sign-in required
clinicianGate.sub: Access is credentialed, requires two-factor sign-in, and is consent-gated. Every entry is logged with timestamp and reason.

clinicianQueue.headline: Your review queue
clinicianQueue.demoRibbon: Demo only — no contracted clinic yet
clinicianQueue.banner: Consent-gated view. Every access is logged with timestamp and reason.

clinicianCase.headline: Mona K.
clinicianCase.banner: Severity flags and trend only — never a diagnosis. Only your own note may introduce medical terminology or trigger referral.
clinicianCase.trendLabel: Trending toward more foggy days over 2 weeks
clinicianCase.referralSent: Referral logged. Mona will be notified through her care team channel.

notifications.ribbon: NOT YET BUILT — SHOWN HERE FOR SHAPE ONLY
notifications.headline: Contextual prompts (examples)
notifications.sub: Not a real screen — a preview of the notification copy the Behavior-change RULES doc describes. These trigger on state, not a fixed schedule, and shrink if ignored rather than escalate.
notifications.example1Copy: "This is a low-energy moment. Here's the easiest possible win."
notifications.example3Copy: "We saved your place. Today's step takes 20 seconds."

settings.headline: Settings
settings.deleteWarning: This can't be undone. (Preview only — no data is actually deleted here.)

manageConsent.headline: Manage consent
manageConsent.sub: Each stage is independent and revocable — turning one off never affects the others.

inviteCaregiver.headline: Invite a caregiver
inviteCaregiver.sub: They'll only ever see stability summaries — never raw scores, individual answers, or exports.
inviteCaregiver.success: Invite sent to {{name}}. They'll see a stability summary only, once accepted.

about.headline: About PreLink & your data
about.banner: PreLink is a wellness and early-support tool. It is not a diagnostic tool and not a substitute for medical advice.
about.sectionTitle: What we show, and to whom
about.footnote: You control what is collected, shared, and deleted. Your data is protected, and you can delete it at any time.

language.headline: Language
language.sub: Choose the language you're most comfortable with.

validations.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters
